title: On Error Resume Next swallows all runtime errors — a bad parse silently returns 0
sourceContent:
Public Class LegacyImport
    Public Function ParseRow(raw As String) As Integer
        On Error Resume Next          ' swallows EVERY runtime error below
        Dim n As Integer = CInt(raw)  ' non-numeric raw -> error swallowed, n stays 0
        Return n                       ' silently returns 0 on bad input
    End Function
End Class
notes: On Error Resume Next continues past any runtime error, leaving variables at their last value. Here a non-numeric input makes CInt throw, the error is swallowed, and the method returns 0 as if the input were valid. A faithful C# port must reproduce the swallow (try/catch returning 0) OR — more likely the real intent — use int.TryParse; the extractor should surface which behaviour is wanted.
